title: Tokki unit-information record
description: One JSON object per line (JSONL). Each object is one 5-arcmin grid cell and carries a list of crops modelled at that cell. The full DSSAT soil profile is NOT stored here; it lives in US.SOL, referenced by soilProfileId.

cell5m.description: MapSPAM flat 5-arcmin grid cell id (row*4320 + col).

x.description: Longitude of cell centre (decimal degrees, WGS84).

y.description: Latitude of cell centre (decimal degrees, WGS84).

soilProfileId.description: DSSAT soil profile id (US + zero-padded cell5m); resolved against US.SOL at run time.

soilRootingDepth.description: Depth to the shallowest restrictive layer (cm).

crops.description: One entry per crop modelled at this cell. Each crop is a self-contained named record (no parallel arrays).

code.description: DSSAT crop code. Extend this list when adding a crop the model supports.

area.description: Physical harvested area in the cell (ha).

waterSupply.description: Dominant water regime: R = rainfed, I = irrigated.

plantingDensity.description: Plants per m^2 at emergence (DSSAT PPOP).

cultivar.description: Optional explicit cultivar for this crop at this cell. When present the model runs exactly this cultivar; when absent it falls back to the latitude-matched maturity rule (Utility.cultivarsForCell). Assigned by the input generator so the file fully documents what was simulated.

code.description: DSSAT 6-character cultivar code, resolved against the crop's CUL file at run time.

name.description: Human-readable cultivar name (as it appears in the CUL); for provenance/readability.
